races.verdict: A tricky race to open the card but STASH THE CASH ended his time with Martin Dunne with a solid second over C&D in the spring and having joined a yard that have done well with new recruits this year, he could be the answer. Midnight Lir is a long time without a win but rates a likely player, with Timebar and Tomarlo next best. STASH THE CASH (IRE) MIDNIGHT LIR (IRE) TIMEBAR

races.display_title: Try Unibet's Superboosts Handicap
races.verdict: A chance is taken on James Owen's new recruit BRAVE LEADER , with confidence in his chance increased should the betting vibes be strong. Ataturk doesn't have the easiest draw but he's made a positive start to his handicap career and is next on the list ahead of Kathleen Mary , who wasn't far behind Hughie Morrison's charge when the pair clashed at Leicester recently and Oisin Murphy takes the reins this time. BRAVE LEADER ATATURK KATHLEEN MARY
